title.narrative: Cote d’Ivoire National Electricity Digitalization and Access operation

description.narrative: The objectives of the Operation are to: (i) increase access to electricity and (ii) improve the quality of electricity service, in the lagging regions of Cote d’Ivoire; and (iii) enhance institutional capacity to support the electrification programs in the country.

The operation seeks to increase access to electricity services in lagging regions of Cote d’Ivoire and improve the quality of service, including through digitalization. Capacity building will also support the implementing agencies' additional PforR responsibilities.

condition.narrative: FA (Schedule 2, Section I, A, 2): no later than three (3) month(s) after the Effective Date, Notwithstanding paragraph 1 above, theRecipient shall establish within its Ministry of Mining, Petroleum and Energy (“MMPE”) by and thereafter maintain throughout theperiod of implementation of the Operation, a steering committee (“Steering Committee”) with terms of reference agreed with theAssociation; which committee shall: (i) be chaired by a representative of MMPE and shall include representatives from theRecipient's ministries responsible for finance, budget, digital economy, planning and development as well as representatives of theOperation Implementing Entity and Compagnie Ivoirienne d’ElectricitE; and (ii) be responsible for providing policy guidance for theimplementation of the Operation, and monitoring and evaluating the performance thereof (and that of the Operation ImplementingEntity), as well as assisting the Operations Implementing Entity with any required inter-agency coordination activities.

OA, Schedule, Section I, A, 1 (b): not later than six (6) months after the Effective Date, select and hire, by and in any eventprior to the commencement of any civil works, and thereafter maintain throughout the period of implementation of the Operation, theservices of an engineering consulting firm with qualifications and experience and under terms of reference acceptable toAssociation, to perform the functions of owner's engineer and assist Operation Coordination Unit with the carrying out of theOperation's activities.

OA, Schedule, Section I, E, 2 (a): not later than six (6) months after the Effective Date, the Operation Implementing Entity shallappoint by and thereafter maintain at all time during the implementation of the Program, one or more independent verificationagents with experience and qualifications and under terms of reference acceptable to the Association (the “Verification Agents”),to: (i) verify the data and other evidence supporting the achievement of the DLIs/DLRs, as set forth in the Disbursement Table; and(ii) recommend corresponding disbursements to be made, as applicable, pursuant to the Disbursement Table.
